items.source: Return a new SpringApplication.Augmented instance with additional sources that should be applied when the application runs.
items.translation: 返回一个新的SpringApplication.Augmented实例，该实例包含在应用程序运行时应应用的额外源。

items.source: Return a new SpringApplication.Augmented instance with additional profiles that should be applied when the application runs.
items.translation: 返回一个新的SpringApplication.Augmented实例，该实例包含在应用程序运行时应应用的额外配置文件。

items.source: Create an application from an existing main method that can run with additional @Configuration or bean classes.
items.translation: 从现有的 `main` 方法创建一个应用程序，使其能够使用额外的 `@Configuration` 或 bean 类运行。
